scripts.test: npm run clean && wdio run config/wdio.conf.ts
scripts.test:browserstack: NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 npm run clean && wdio run config/wdio.browserstack.conf.ts
scripts.test:local: npm run clean && wdio run config/wdio.local.conf.ts
scripts.test:local:debug: npm run clean && DEBUG=true wdio run config/wdio.local.conf.ts
scripts.test:github: npm run clean && wdio run config/wdio.github.conf.ts
scripts.test:github:browserstack: npm run clean && wdio run config/wdio.github.browserstack.conf.ts
scripts.git:pre-commit-hook: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.setup:husky: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
